profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | React.js, Microsoft Azure, .NET Core
profile.summary: With over 18 years of experience in software engineering, my journey has led me to Verisma Systems, where I currently innovate as a Senior Software Engineer. Leveraging my proficiency in React.js and .NET Core, I've been instrumental in developing solutions that enhance healthcare technology. At Space Genius, I embraced leadership, steering our team to success with my strong technical competencies. My mission aligns with creating impactful software that not only meets but exceeds industry standards, and I'm committed to bringing a strategic vision and diverse perspectives to our projects at Verisma Systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and delivered secure API key lifecycle and authorization capabilities for distributed backend services, improving access governance, auditability, and external integration control. Built production reporting APIs supporting JSON, CSV, XML, and NDJSON outputs across asynchronous reporting workflows. Improved audit logging, traceability, and operational visibility across service interactions to support production debugging and compliance needs. Strengthened resiliency and supportability of asynchronous backend processing, including background jobs, export workflows, and operational failure handling. Partnered with product, QA, and engineering stakeholders to deliver backend features, production fixes, and platform improvements. Contributed to architecture, implementation, testing, release planning, and production support for customer-facing systems.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: • Founded and built a language-learning platform focused on practical, region-specific Spanish learning • Designed and developed the platform across frontend, backend, authentication, subscription billing, and deployment • Built core product features for lesson delivery, speaking practice, user progress tracking, and premium subscriptions • Implemented AI-assisted tutoring and personalized learning workflows to improve engagement and retention • Led technical architecture, product decisions, release planning, and ongoing platform iteration as the primary engineer • Integrated React, Supabase, Stripe, Vercel, and cloud-based APIs into a production SaaS platform
